# AgentHub (llms.txt)

> Unified remote continuation & control plane for official AI coding agent runtimes (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity & ACP).
> Full technical specification: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)

AgentHub connects local CLI coding agents to remote browsers, mobile PWAs, and Android devices without reinventing an inference loop. `agenthub-runner` (single Rust binary) owns native sessions locally, serves an embedded console at `http://127.0.0.1:4200`, and initiates outbound-only TLS/WSS connections to a self-hosted Gateway for live streaming, redacted diff approvals, multi-select questions, and turn interrupts.

## Quick Start
1. Local Runner: `agenthub-runner web` (`http://127.0.0.1:4200`) or `agenthub-runner daemon`
2. Full Stack from Source:
   - `npm ci`
   - `npm start --workspace @agent-pulse/api` (Gateway API on `:3001`)
   - `npm run dev --workspace @agent-pulse/web` (Vite Web UI on `:5173`)

## Key Technical Facts
- Version: 2.7.9 | License: MIT (Copyright 2026 Tanner) | Repo: https://github.com/xiaoran7/agenthub
- Pure Rust 2024 runner (`~13.5 MB` steady RSS) with on-demand isolated WebView2 UI child (`agenthub-runner ui`), native Win32 tray, `UsageIndexDb` cold/hot SQLite usage ledger, and federated Skill/MCP/Hook library.
- Static Web front-door: Vite 8 MPA + `nginx:1.29-alpine` same-origin proxy (`~8.4 MiB` RAM), paired with a Kotlin + Jetpack Compose Remote v3 Android client (`apps/android`).
- Security: Outbound-only WSS, Ed25519 device auth, `ws-*` path redaction, 64 KiB diff cap, single-writer `host_generation` fencing, and `client_cmd_id` idempotency.
- Primary docs: [docs/README.md](docs/README.md), [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), [docs/SYNC_PROTOCOL.md](docs/SYNC_PROTOCOL.md), [docs/DEPLOYMENT.md](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md).
